note: Closed list of perturbations the factory applies, read by scripts/user_path_failures.py `perturbation_axis` (the one reader; `failure_axis` is its `request_failure` view) for the S3 request rows, and by `perturbation_axes` for the S6 brief, which prints every axis as `Exploration cells:`. A kind is what the run does to the world (`fail_request` is the runner's own step: a url glob and a status 400-599 or `timeout`); `steps` are lines of a `ui --steps-file` with placeholders the runner fills (the selector and the values are the page's, open variety the code does not know); the oracle is what must stay true while it happens, taken from the requirements and never from the code (FR-58).

kinds.why: the dependency answers an error: fetch does not throw, the page must look at the status
the dependency never answers: the call rejects, the page must leave its loading state

axes.oracle: the page stays alive (the rest of it still shows), the person is told of the error in words, and no data is lost silently

axes.subject: every input field of the flow you meet

kinds.why: a value saved on every change is cut at the first character when the page redraws
an emptied field sends null or not-a-number
an inserted value reaches no key handler
a value past the limit is clamped silently or refused in words

axes.oracle: the value typed is kept whole, the field keeps its focus, and a value the product refuses is refused in words

axes.subject: every action that saves

kinds.why: a save in flight is lost, applied twice or shown as saved when it was not

axes.oracle: after the reload the page shows what was saved and nothing else, and an unsaved change is told

axes.subject: every sign-in you can reach with state built as a guest

steps: click <the control that builds the guest state>
kinds.why: state built before sign-in is merged into the account: it is dropped, doubled or replaced

steps: fail_request <the glob of the merge request> 500
kinds.why: the merge call fails while the sign-in still says success: the state is gone with no word

axes.oracle: after the sign-in the account holds what was built as a guest, or the person is told in words what was not kept
